stories.title: Parandur airport: Development vs environment debate returns to Tamil Nadu | The Hindu Editorial
stories.summary: The Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) government has scrapped the ₹27,400 crore Parandur greenfield airport project near Chennai, citing concerns over farmers, residents and waterbodies. While supporters see it as a victory for local communities, critics warn the move could impact Chennai’s long-term infrastructure and aviation growth.

stories.title: Russia ranks fourth by number of billionaires in 2025 — study
stories.summary: The United States remained the leading country by the number of billionaires
article_sentences: Russia consolidated its position as the country with the fourth-largest billionaire population in 2025, according to a study published by analytical company Altrata.

"Russia consolidated its position as the fourth-largest billionaire country, with the population and wealth holdings boosted by strong currency and interest-rate effects, and rising (non-oil) commodities revenue amid redirected trade to Asia," the company said in its study.
Russia had 151 billionaires at the end of last year, up 18% from a year earlier, according to Altrata’s estimates.
Their combined wealth stood at $549 billion.
The United States remained the leading country by the number of billionaires, with 1,265 people worth more than $1 billion at the end of last year.
New York was home to the largest number of billionaires - 164.

stories.title: Share of foreign investment in Russian federal loan bonds up to 3.1% in July — regulator
stories.summary: As of July 1, 2026, the share of non-residents in OFZ equaled 3%
article_sentences: The share of foreign investment in Russia’s federal loan (OFZ) bonds was up at 3.1% as of August 1, 2026, according to files released by the Bank of Russia.
As of July 1, 2026, the share of non-residents in OFZ equaled 3%.
As of August 1, 2025, that share stood at 3.8%.
Nominal amount of OFZ owned by non-residents as of the beginning of August 2026 totaled 1.011 trillion rubles ($11.7 bln) with the total volume of the market at 32.958 trillion rubles ($383.7 bln).
